Little by little, things began to change. The coffee corner has become an important part of daily life. There are always more possibilities than we expect. The neighbors settled their dispute through mediation.

The meeting room looked quieter than usual that evening. At first, Grace found it difficult to keep the habit. Grace believes that trying new things keeps life fresh. I'm certain the keys are in the car.

People around Grace often share different ideas about the meeting room. What matters most is not speed, but keeping on. Grace bought a pair of shoes online because it was much cheaper. Best of all, the plumber fixed the kitchen tap.

There is still a long way to go, but the direction is right. Grace prefers windy weather when running in the museum. Sometimes a short talk can solve a big problem. Also, scope creep pushed the app's release back twice.
Anna always says that small steps matter more than big plans. Grace's dream job is to be a teacher. The experience taught Grace more than any book could.
